"""
G_ij = { P_ij + J_ij  if  ( i , j ) ∈ E
        0 otherwise

        G_jk += { ( j , k ) ∈ F : P_jk + J_jk
        0 otherwise

        where
        P: ℝ ^ (4 × 4): a matrix
        J: ℝ ^ (4 × 4): a matrix
        G: ℝ ^ (10 × 10): a matrix
        E: { ℤ × ℤ } index
        F: { ℤ × ℤ } index
"""
import numpy as np
import scipy
import scipy.linalg
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.integrate import quad, solve_ivp
from scipy.optimize import minimize


class heartlib:
    def __init__(self, P, J, E, F):
        P = np.asarray(P, dtype=np.float64)
        J = np.asarray(J, dtype=np.float64)
        E = frozenset(E)
        F = frozenset(F)
        assert P.shape == (4, 4)
        assert J.shape == (4, 4)
        assert all( len(el) == 2 for el in E )
        assert all( len(el) == 2 for el in F )
        # G_ij = { P_ij + J_ij  if  ( i , j ) ∈ E
        #         0 otherwise
        Gij_0 = []
        Gvals_0 = []
        for tuple in E:
            i = tuple[0]+1
            j = tuple[1]+1
            Gij_0.append((i-1, j-1))
            Gvals_0.append(P[i-1, j-1] + J[i-1, j-1])
        sparse_0 = scipy.sparse.coo_matrix((Gvals_0, np.asarray(Gij_0).T), shape=(10, 10))
        self.G = sparse_0
        # G_jk += { ( j , k ) ∈ F : P_jk + J_jk
        #         0 otherwise
        Gij_0 = []
        Gvals_0 = []
        for tuple_1 in F:
            j = tuple_1[0]+1
            k = tuple_1[1]+1
            Gij_0.append((j-1, k-1))
            Gvals_0.append(P[j-1, k-1] + J[j-1, k-1])
        G = scipy.sparse.coo_matrix((Gvals_0+self.G.data.tolist(), np.hstack((np.asarray(Gij_0).T, np.asarray((self.G.row, self.G.col))))), shape=(10, 10))
        self.G = G
